entities.summary: Maria Jansson, known in history as Kisamor [ˈɕiːsaˌmuːr], was a Swedish natural doctor, one of the most notable and well-known of 19th-century physicians in Sweden. She is also a prominent example of a cunning woman in her country. The nickname Kisamor stems from the place where she worked.
